{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: CIRCL
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  amd64_job:
    name: Go-${{matrix.GOVER}}/amd64
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        GOVER: ['1.26', '1.25']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go-${{ matrix.GOVER }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GOVER }}
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Linting
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: v2.12.2
      - name: Check shadowing
        run: |
         # Pin x/tools to a version compatible with the oldest Go version in the CI matrix.
         go install golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis/passes/shadow/cmd/shadow@v0.49.0
         go vet -vettool=$(which shadow) ./... 2>&1 | awk -f .etc/action.awk
        shell: bash
      - name: Verifying Code
        run: |
         go generate -v ./...
         test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
         go vet ./...
        shell: bash
      - name: Building
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./...
  arm64_job:
    name: Go-${{matrix.GOVER}}/arm64
    needs: [amd64_job]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    strategy:
      matrix:
        GOVER: ['1.26', '1.25']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go-${{ matrix.GOVER }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GOVER }}
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Building
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./...
  wasm_job:
    needs: [amd64_job]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: Testing on WASM
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Setting WASM Runtime
        run: echo $(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Building
        run: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go test -v -count=1 ./...
  build_modes:
    needs: [amd64_job]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: Testing Build Modes
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Build as Static
        run: make circl_static
      - name: Build as Plugin
        run: make circl_plugin
  coverage_amd64_job:
    needs: [amd64_job]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: amd64/coverage
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Produce Coverage
        run: go test -coverprofile=./coverage.txt ./...
      - name: Upload Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          files: ./coverage.txt
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
  osCompat:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [amd64_job]
    name: Running on ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Building
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./...
  analyze:
    name: Analyze with CodeQL
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4
        with:
          languages: go
      - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4
        with:
          category: "/language:go"
",
  "rationale": "The workflow executes multiple jobs (amd64, arm64, WASM, build modes, coverage, macOS, Windows, CodeQL) across Go versions 1.25 and 1.26, each downloading Go dependencies. Adding a Go module cache step (actions/cache@v4) keyed by all go.mod/go.sum files avoids repeated downloads. Evidence from experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 shows a 6% elapsed time reduction for a similar Go workflow, and pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE reports 3.4-6% VM time reduction. This change preserves all build, test, and analysis coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
